date_scope_check.qualification_retained: R5-ME-002-NP1: The embassy dates the restriction to the evening of July 5, 2018. Al Wattan reports travellers describing passage restored on July 6 afternoon, whereas SABA records continuing diplomatic efforts on July 7 and more than fifty qualifying owner-driven SUVs entering Yemen on July 9. The early report does not identify the same ownership or vehicle subclasses precisely enough to reconcile continuity. July 9 is a supported passage bound, not necessarily the first reopening. Shas/Hilux and heavy-equipment endpoints remain unknown. The official purpose is unestablished; no motive is inferred. Numeric duration and animation remain held because same-cohort continuity is unresolved.
